chrome.platformSubtitle: National Freight & Procurement Intelligence · Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways / Ministry of Coal
chrome.emblemAlt: State Emblem of India Slot (Authorized Government Asset)
chrome.cvcBannerText: This is a decision-support system only. Final chartering, vessel fixation or coal procurement action requires review and approval by an authorized officer under the applicable delegation and procurement framework.
chrome.sidebarReviewNoteText: AI-assisted recommendations remain subject to authorized approval under Delegation of Financial Powers (DoFP).
chrome.footerDisclaimer: Outputs are advisory and based on the data and model versions shown. They do not constitute a procurement decision, a contractual commitment or an official maritime warning. Modelled figures may differ from contractual amounts.
chrome.footerAccessibility: Accessibility Statement: Designed in accordance with GIGW & WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Fully functional offline.
chrome.footerDeployment: Deployment: Local, air-gapped decision support system · Smart India Hackathon
chrome.statusMock: Sample mode · No live data in use

overview.landingHeroHeadline: From market signal to governed decision
overview.landingHeroBody: The Maritime Chartering Platform brings freight markets, vessel suitability, port conditions, risk and cost comparison into one place. It helps an authorized officer see the full picture before recommending a chartering or coal procurement action. Every result is advisory. Final decisions remain with the competent authority.
overview.trustBadge1: Decision support only, not automatic procurement
overview.trustBadge2: Runs locally, no internet needed for core analysis
overview.trustBadge3: Every decision recorded in an audit trail
overview.kpiCurrentSpotRateHelper: USD per tonne for the selected route
overview.kpiCurrentSpotRateTooltip: The latest freight price for a voyage on the selected route and vessel class.
overview.kpiMarketRegimeTooltip: The overall direction of the freight market. Bullish means rates are expected to rise.
overview.kpiOpportunitySignalHelper: Is now a good time to fix?
overview.kpiOpportunitySignalTooltip: A screening signal that weighs freight, fuel, port pressure and market direction. It is not an instruction to buy.
overview.kpiBalticTooltip: Standard market benchmarks for dry bulk shipping. Compare them with the route rate to see whether the route is moving with the wider market.
overview.kpiUnavailable: Figure unavailable. The service did not respond.
overview.kpiSampleData: Sample data. Not live market information.
overview.formIntro: Choose a route and date to see the current market picture. Use this page first to decide which route or vessel deserves a closer look on the other pages.
overview.originHelp: The country or region where the cargo is loaded.
overview.vesselClassHelp: The ship size category. Panamax and Capesize are the most common for coal.
overview.asOfDateHelp: The date for which the market is assessed. Defaults to today.
overview.howToStep1Desc: Select origin, destination, vessel class and date, or press 'Load example'.
overview.howToStep2Desc: Press 'Generate market intelligence'. The platform assembles the market picture for that route.
overview.howToStep3Desc: Read the signal, then move to Forecast, Vessel and Port pages for detail. This page never approves anything.
overview.emptyStateTitle: Your market picture will appear here
overview.emptyStateText: Once you run the analysis, you will see the market direction, whether to fix or wait, price movements, fuel and coal prices, forward freight curves and recent charter history for your route.
overview.fivePillarsTitle: The Five Pillars of Freight Intelligence
overview.recommendedWorkflowDesc: The order can change with the business question. The principle is to combine market, model, operational, economic and governance evidence rather than rely on a single score.
